systems.owner: Ministry of Education and National Education, with UNESCO

note: SUNA dispatch of 2025-09-23: the minister chaired a coordination meeting with UNESCO in Port Sudan on developing the EMIS under the Transitional Education Plan 2025-2027, and the Interior Ministry pledged data linkage on students. The system is named and not described: nothing on what it records or who enters it, so no class and no fact.
